parameters.title: Insert tabular data from spreadsheet directly into the database
parameters.label: Translate tabular data recorded as csv or excel files to xSpatula json command process files, and immediately apply them to the database in one step.

parameter.hint: Absolute or relative path of the spreadsheet source data
Absolute or relative destination path for writing the staging json process file
Only for target process manage_taxon: default taxonomy reference name (e.g. silva), overridden per row by a taxonomy_reference column
Only for target process manage_taxon: default taxonomy reference version, overridden per row by a taxonomy_reference_version column
Only for target process manage_edna_asv: name of the method pipeline (observation_utility.method_pipeline) that produced the ASVs, e.g. ai4sh-16s
